# Review: plan:ctx-max

Head:819b43229bbc4d0db0bbac7dd3a76885e6fb85a9. Direct parent:4fa6ed9da056d5d3fbbb9f189205ba03301645af. Reviewer:pij-unaware-quokka. Answers request01a1ce59-f6c3-77e0-8a58-e072656e589b.

## Verdict: BLOCK

OneP2 selection defect. Named20%/72%/40% and no-data/identity acceptance scenarios pass; over-capacity reports can name the wrong fullest agent. Author acknowledged and reports an uncommitted fix; no credit until a landed corrective SHA and gate.

## MEDIUM / P2 — Rank with the raw fraction, not display-clamped fill

**Location:** `apps/web/src/features/064-terminal/lib/context-fill.ts:72`.

fullestContext compares contextFill(context), which clamps used/window into0–1 for the bar. A first seat reporting1,000,000/1,000,000 and a later seat reporting1,200,000/1,000,000 both compare1, so the first seat is retained and named fullest. The brief explicitly requires highest used/window fraction;1.2 is greater than1. This is supported input, not speculative malformed data: existing helper documentation and tests expressly allow reported usage above the window.

**Independent source-module reproduction:** actual imported819function selects `exactly-full` for1.0before1.2. **Actual retained-build reproduction:** controlled cards bound to three real private-pane PIDs at1.0/1.2/0.4 make BOTH strip and overview display `context 100% (1.0M / 1.0M), fullest of 3 agents: review-identity`, rather than the1.2seat review-fullest. Saved `/tmp/reviewer-ctx819-proof.json` and `/tmp/reviewer-ctx819-overflow-defect.png`.

**Fix:** compare unclamped usedTokens/windowTokens for ranking; keep clamping only the rendered bar/percentage. Equal raw fractions must still preserve earlier pane order. Add consumer-visible regression for100%then120% and equal mixed-capacity ratios. Author reports exactly this local fix plus a test;14targetedpass author-reported, not independently credited to819.

## Integration review

- Activity sampling still joins a seat by pane ID AND matching root/descendant PID, preserving pane-recycling protection. It collects matching seats in pane order; first seat still drives identity/name/badges, while only context selects fullest.
- Fresh samples replace context; seatless/departed windows clear mappings. Existing pending/unseen-pane safeguards remain.
- Multiple cards sharing one pane still collapse through pre-existing seatsByPane Map; not introduced by this patch and outside the tiled-one-agent-per-pane brief.
- Count means context-reporting seats; no-data seats are excluded. All-null input yields null and renders no bar, not an empty0%bar.
- WindowContext expanded data reaches socket dispatch/singleton/header/overview. Source consumers and changed tests were reviewed against the author worktree/exactGitobject, not the older main checkout.
- Terminal domain documentation updated; no new domain/component relationship requiring a newC4 diagram found.

## Independent final-artifact browser proof

Reused author worktree `/Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass-ctx-max`, retained BUILD_ID`pQ0q6Rh571DGyBy46czP6`; no rebuild/copy. Next3107 and source sidecar4607, nice19. Valid bootstrap200 plus signed Auth.js fixture; not OAuth-login proof.

**Telemetry boundary:** private HTTP7499 served controlled/v1/cards data, with a non-secret fixture key/stateDir; no real daemon key or state was modified. Cards were bound to actual pane IDs/PIDs from real three-pane scratch windows. This exercises the real sidecar sampler/process-tree join, WebSocket serialization, retained client bundle, tooltip and overview. It is NOT actual running agents or native telemetry, and is not presented as such.

Private isolation established BEFORE any Next/sidecar:mkdir/chmod700`/tmp/review-ctx819-tmux`; resolution and actual explicit-S display named `/private/tmp/review-ctx819-tmux/tmux-501/default`. The page's session query did not select the manually created ctx819proof; actual socket reported auto-sessionchainglass-ctx-max, so only that **private** auto-session was tiled and used. This never reached Jordan's default tmux. No-default-touch assumption was independently checked by socket paths, not inferred from an unsetTMUX variable.

Actual surfaces:
- Three panes20/72/40: window identityreview-identity; label`context 72% (720k / 1.0M), fullest of 3 agents: review-fullest`; one orange strip bar.
- Open overview and chooseAll (Recent correctly excluded this idle scratch window): both bars have identical72%accessible labels/orangeband. `/tmp/reviewer-ctx819-overview.png`.
- Remove all usage fields from controlled roster: both bars disappear; identity staysreview-identity. `/tmp/reviewer-ctx819-no-data.png`.
- Overfull1.0/1.2/0.4: both surfaces reproduce P2 above.
- Shell remains interactive: typed arithmetic CTX_REVIEW_42 received over the real terminalWebSocket. No browser console errors or pageerror exceptions observed in this prepared worktree.

Inspected `/tmp/reviewer-ctx819-strip-tooltip.png`, overview/no-data screenshots; overflow result JSON retains head/build/expectedvsactual. Author's screenshots under governance reports/ctx-max-evidence were also read but predate final build and use a stand-in roster; they are authored evidence, not silently counted as final independent proof.
